rebuttal_or_critique: I must express my profound concern regarding the complacency shown by some members toward a 7.44% headline inflation print. Attributing a surge of this magnitude solely to 'transitory' food price shocks ignores the risk of second-round effects and the unanchoring of inflation expectations. When headline inflation breaches the upper tolerance band so decisively, the credibility of our 4% target is at stake. Furthermore, with a positive output gap of 0.60% and systemic liquidity at 120,000 crore, the argument that we are over-correcting is mathematically inconsistent with the reality of excess liquidity fueling inflationary pressure. We cannot allow the real policy rate to be eroded by supply-side volatility; proactive tightening is the only way to ensure the disinflationary path remains durable.
